name: Eglah
title: David's wife
summary: Eglah was one of King David's wives in Hebron. She was the mother of Ithream, who was David's sixth son born in Hebron before he became king over all Israel.

keyEvents.title: Marriage with David in Hebron
keyEvents.description: Eglah became one of David's wives while he reigned as king over Judah in Hebron, before he became king over all Israel.

keyEvents.title: Mother of Ithream
keyEvents.description: Eglah bore Ithream, David's sixth son in Hebron. He is mentioned in the list of David's sons along with his half-brothers.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Eglah and her son Ithream are also mentioned in Chronicles' list of David's sons born in Hebron.
